Join us for a ceramics workshop at the
Fairmount University Arts Center!
Explore pottery techniques with instructor Mei Chang
on April 12, from 1:00 to 4:00 P.M.
Materials are provided.
All skill levels welcome.
For registration, contact artscenter@fairmountuniversity.edu.
